# ToolRank: full rankings

Last updated 2026-10-15. Source: https://toolrank.io/. Editorial ranking; position 1 = top pick. Pricing labels: free / freemium / paid (as listed; verify with vendor).


## AI Assistants

General-purpose AI chat assistants for everyday questions, writing and thinking.
Page: https://toolrank.io/best/ai-assistants/

1. ChatGPT (freemium; audience: both): Most versatile general assistant for drafting. https://chatgpt.com
2. Claude (freemium; audience: both): Strong long-form writing quality and natural tone. https://claude.ai
3. Google Gemini (freemium; audience: both): Google's assistant for drafting and editing, integrated with Workspace. https://gemini.google.com
4. Microsoft Copilot (freemium; audience: both): Microsoft's assistant, also built into Word and Outlook. https://copilot.microsoft.com
5. Grok (freemium; audience: consumer): xAI's assistant with real-time X data. https://grok.com
6. Le Chat (Mistral) (freemium; audience: both): Mistral AI's assistant with web search, documents and fast answers. https://chat.mistral.ai

## Coding & App Building

Build apps from a prompt, or code faster with AI pair programmers and agents.
Page: https://toolrank.io/best/coding/

1. Cursor (freemium; audience: business): AI-native code editor with strong agent mode and codebase context. https://www.cursor.com
2. Lovable (freemium; audience: consumer): Prompt-to-full-stack web app builder aimed at non-developers. https://lovable.dev
3. Claude Code (paid; audience: business): Anthropic's terminal-based agentic coding tool. https://www.anthropic.com/claude-code
4. Bolt.new (freemium; audience: consumer): Builds and runs full-stack apps in the browser from a prompt. https://bolt.new
5. GitHub Copilot (freemium; audience: business): Most widely integrated assistant across IDEs and GitHub. https://github.com/features/copilot
6. v0 (freemium; audience: consumer): Vercel's generator for React/Next.js UIs and apps, deploys to Vercel. https://v0.app
7. OpenAI Codex (paid; audience: business): OpenAI's coding agent across CLI, IDE and cloud. https://openai.com/codex
8. Replit (freemium; audience: both): Replit Agent builds, hosts and deploys apps from one cloud workspace. https://replit.com
9. Windsurf (freemium; audience: business): Agentic IDE alternative to Cursor. https://windsurf.com
10. Base44 (freemium; audience: both): Prompt-to-app builder with built-in database, auth and hosting; owned by Wix. https://base44.com
11. Gemini CLI (free; audience: business): Google's open-source terminal coding agent powered by Gemini. https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli
12. Google AI Studio (Build) (free; audience: both): Google's AI Studio builds and deploys Gemini-powered apps from a prompt. https://aistudio.google.com
13. JetBrains AI (Junie) (paid; audience: business): JetBrains' coding agent inside IntelliJ-based IDEs. https://junie.jetbrains.com/
14. Firebase Studio (free; audience: both): Google's cloud workspace for prototyping full-stack apps with Gemini. https://firebase.studio
15. Cline (free; audience: business): Open-source autonomous coding agent for VS Code; bring your own model. https://cline.bot
16. Create.xyz (Anything) (freemium; audience: consumer): Prompt-to-app builder for web and mobile apps. https://www.createanything.com
17. Kilo Code (freemium; audience: business): Open-source coding agent for VS Code and JetBrains. https://kilo.ai
18. Rork (freemium; audience: consumer): Builds native mobile apps (React Native) from a prompt. https://rork.com
19. Aider (free; audience: business): Open-source terminal pair programmer that commits to git. https://aider.chat
20. Softgen (paid; audience: consumer): AI web app builder producing Next.js apps with Firebase/Supabase. https://softgen.ai
21. Amp (freemium; audience: business): Sourcegraph-born agentic coding tool for terminal and editors. https://ampcode.com
22. Tempo (freemium; audience: consumer): Visual React editor with AI that generates and edits code. https://www.tempo.new
23. Zed (freemium; audience: business): Fast open-source code editor with built-in AI agent. https://zed.dev
24. Same (freemium; audience: consumer): Clones or builds web apps from a prompt or URL. https://same.new
25. Amazon Q Developer (freemium; audience: business): AWS coding assistant for IDEs and CLI. https://aws.amazon.com/q/developer/
26. Macaly (freemium; audience: consumer): Prompt-to-website and app builder for non-developers. https://www.macaly.com

30. Bubble (freemium; audience: both): Established no-code platform with an AI app generator. https://bubble.io
31. Devin (paid; audience: business): Cognition's autonomous software engineering agent. https://devin.ai
